# Broadcastwell

> Broadcastwell is an AI search visibility agency for vertical B2B software companies. We measure how often AI engines name a vendor in buyer answers, then build the third-party evidence those engines read.

Free 10-question check: ten buyer questions for your category on one engine, Perplexity, returning your position on the absence ladder and the chapter of The Absence Manual that addresses it. Runs in the browser in under a minute. An email address is used only to enforce one result per address per day. Addresses are kept for 24 months, with no mailing list. https://audit.broadcastwell.com
Category Audit: $490 once. One category, ten buyer questions, five engines, three measured runs. Which vendors the engines named instead with counts, which of the ten questions you lose, the sources the engines read to answer, your position on the absence ladder, and a written findings document with three prioritised fixes. Findings within 48 hours of the category being confirmed by email. The full $490 is credited against the Diagnostic if the Diagnostic is bought within 30 days. Buy it at https://buy.stripe.com/dRm7sM3R23Mo0Dv6sDds400
AI Visibility Diagnostic: 35 category-defining buyer questions across ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews and Google AI Mode, with three scheduled runs per question and engine and up to two further runs on any pair whose verdicts disagreed: 525 scheduled observed answers, named and cited outcomes reported separately with numerator, denominator and a 95 percent confidence interval, competitor and source analysis, limitations, run-to-run spread, a receipts appendix, machine-readable data files, and a prioritised evidence, content and distribution plan. $990 once. The full $990 Diagnostic fee credits against the program's first monthly invoice. Buy it at https://buy.stripe.com/4gM7sMgDOdmYbi93grds401
The Program: $13,500 per 90 days, billed $4,500 monthly, with a 90 day initial term, then month to month. Client stories are published only with explicit approval; reviews are optional and never required or incentivized.
Agency Wholesale: $1,000 per client per month for the first client and $490 per client per month for each additional client. Per client, per month, under the agency name: the fixed question set re-measured on five engines with three runs each, a written client-facing findings report naming who is named instead of the client and the sources visible in those answers, the fixes stated as which page to update and which publisher to get in front of, reported by question type, and crawler access checked. One Diagnostic on one of your clients, free, delivered under your name, so you can see the work before you buy. No minimum. Monthly term. Details at https://broadcastwell.com/for-agencies
The Absence Manual, free and ungated, 13 chapters and 5 appendices: https://docs.broadcastwell.com/ (PDF: https://docs.broadcastwell.com/absence-manual.pdf)
Reporting cadence: brand mentions, citations and the sources engines pull from are reported every month. The 35 question re-score across five engines runs every quarter, because one run is not a trend and a monthly headline score cannot separate signal from run-to-run variance. Month one is a baseline, not a verdict.
90-day proof gate: At the day-90 re-score, the named count must be strictly greater than baseline on the same agreed questions, engines and method version. A tie fails. If the gate is not met, Broadcastwell does not invoice month four and you may end the engagement with no further charge. Under the current terms, v1.1 covers all 35 agreed questions across five engines. The panel is frozen, each question-and-engine cell counts once, and cells lost to engine errors are excluded from both sides and reported. Except under the refund clause, months one to three are not refundable. No inclusion, ranking, revenue or commercial result is guaranteed. The baseline is the first Diagnostic run under the method version named in the contract. For v1.1, the frozen 35-question panel has 175 question-and-engine cells, including 50 cells for the ten shortlist questions. The same questions, five engines and method version are used at baseline and the day-90 re-score. Each cell uses the verdict defined by the method: unanimous across the three scheduled runs, or the majority after adaptive reruns. Extra adaptive answers never inflate the cell count. Cells lost to engine errors are excluded from both comparisons, with the common denominator and exclusions reported. Named means named; tone is not scored. Question groups are reported separately. You retain all runs, answers, citations and sources. Engagements under an earlier method remain on their agreed version.
Money back if it is not the right fit: If Broadcastwell is not the right fit, you get your money back. A standalone Category Audit or AI Visibility Diagnostic is refundable in full, no questions asked, if requested within 30 days of delivery of the findings. The first month of the program is refundable in full, no questions asked, at any time before month two is invoiced. You do not need to give a reason, and you keep every deliverable produced up to that point. The only exception is third-party costs paid on your behalf, and we tell you about any of those before they are incurred.
Receipts on every answer: every observed answer is delivered to the client in full, with the engine that returned it, the date and time it ran, and every source it cited, wins and losses alike. No figure is reported that cannot be traced back to the answers underneath it.
Prompt classes are never blended: no question in the Diagnostic names any brand, whether the client or a competitor. The 35 generic buyer questions are grouped into ten shortlist, ten buyer role, ten use case and five evaluation questions. Any separate branded comparison is reported separately and never folded into the headline.
Your data leaves with you: the question set, citation logs, observed answers and reports belong to the client, returned in an open, machine-readable format within five business days of the request and at no charge if the engagement ends, for any reason.
The published account: where a reduced rate is agreed it is a trade rather than a discount, exchanged for a published account of the work stating what was measured, what was changed and what moved. Published only with the client's explicit written approval.

## Offer record, current as of 11 September 2026

Authoritative current offer record: https://broadcastwell.com/company-facts. Legal master: https://broadcastwell.com/terms.

Agency wholesale worked totals: one client $1,000 a month, three clients $1,980 a month, five clients $2,960 a month; each additional client $490 per month.

Partner Network: $225 per paid Diagnostic referral; 10% of collected program revenue for up to 12 paid months. No commission on the $490 Category Audit. A referred buyer who starts at the Category Audit and upgrades within 30 days earns the partner the Diagnostic commission.

Method v1.1: Claude, ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews and Google AI Mode. 525 scheduled observed answers; adaptive observations are extra and reported separately. AI answers vary, so repeated observations and disagreements are retained. Presence is measured, tone is not. The headline comparison uses the scheduled fixed panel.

Named B2B software case: Vantaa Tax, an AI-native indirect-tax intelligence software platform serving SaaS and ecommerce companies, founded in Australia. Its fixed ten-question benchmark on four AI surfaces is an early, directional tracked AI-visibility measurement, not traffic, revenue, ranking or compliance performance. https://broadcastwell.com/vantaa-tax-ai-visibility-case-study

Other approved client references: Neurvalis, Diagnostic then program, engagement facts only; Valren Atelier, online-first leather-goods brand, baseline AI visibility audit and strategic guidance, no performance claim, external link https://instagram.com/valrenatelier.

## Research

- [https://broadcastwell.com/state-of-geo]: The 2026 State of GEO. 860 answers scored on one engine held constant, Claude Sonnet with live web search, with the method published in full.
- [https://broadcastwell.com/absence-ladder]: The Absence Ladder. How the shape of a company's AI invisibility changes as its visibility rises.
- [https://broadcastwell.com/engine-divergence]: Engine divergence. Whether four AI search engines return the same vendors, measured against each engine's own run-to-run noise across 280 B2B buyer questions in 40 categories.
- [https://broadcastwell.com/geo-statistics]: GEO and AI search visibility statistics 2026. The key figures from all three studies as citable lines, each with its DOI.
- [https://broadcastwell.com/visibility]: AI visibility measurement framework. A clearly labelled illustrative four-engine scorecard and the protocol used for client baselines and re-scores.
- [https://broadcastwell.com/geo-agencies-measured]: GEO agencies measured. A dated category research snapshot showing how name-seeded prompts can inflate raw mention counts.
- [https://broadcastwell.com/improve-ai-search-visibility]: How to improve AI search visibility. What moves a vendor into AI answers, and what does not.
- [https://broadcastwell.com/geo-vs-seo]: GEO vs SEO. What differs mechanically between ranking and being named, grounded in three open datasets.
